title: Bring Your App to NPC Hackathon Bounty 2
description:
Your App deserves a Club of its own.

NPC Season One is bringing together 25 Clubs for a two-week Club App Hackathon, with $1,500 in prizes.

We're looking for builders ready to bring their existing Apps, create a Club, and bring people together around what they've built.

How to participate:

1. Apply to NPC Season One with an existing, working App or Mini App.
2. Tell us how you'd bring your App and community together through a Club.
3. Submit a poidh claim with a screenshot of your App, its live link, and the App name used in your application.

Reward: $10 in ETH for the verified, qualifying claim on this bounty.

NPC will verify completed applications and App ownership or authorization before awarding the bounty. The earliest submitted claim that meets all requirements wins, regardless of when verification is completed.

You must own or represent the App and submit your application and poidh claim by November 1. One bounty reward per builder/team across this campaign. Each bounty has one winner. Applying does not guarantee hackathon acceptance.

25 Clubs. 2 weeks. 5 winners.

Bring or Build an App. Build your Club. Find your crew.

Apply through the NPC Farcaster Mini App:
https://farcaster.xyz/miniapps/xyY8mvp8w_Kl/npc

Or visit https://npc.nexus

claims.title: AetherScan: Solana Execution & Validator Telemetry (@RizulChauhan)
claims.description:
AetherScan is a minimalist, institutional execution receipt and validator telemetry explorer built for high-throughput Solana transactions.

Features:
- Visual execution pipeline (Client Dispatch -> Jupiter V6 -> Raydium CLMM -> Jito Finalization)
- Real-time BankingStage multi-threaded TPU scheduler tracking
- Dynamic Compute Unit budget efficiency visualization (65.7% CU utilization)
- Dual-segment fee breakdown (Base 5k lamports + Priority 6.8k lamports)
- Address Lookup Table (LUT v0) memory compaction analysis

Open Source Repo: https://github.com/RizulChauhan/solana-validator-telemetry-app
Creator: @RizulChauhan

claims.title: Solana Receipt — Live App (@swiftbotlab)
claims.description:
App name in NPC Season One application: Solana Receipt
Live app link: https://swiftbotlab.github.io/solscan-receipt-redesign/tx.html
Screenshot: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swiftbotlab/solscan-receipt-redesign/69cfcd1f341ff1edef3ed0a8801460ed538a4b8b/img/solana-receipt-app.png
Source: https://github.com/swiftbotlab/solscan-receipt-redesign (our repo; the app footer links github.com/swiftbotlab)
NPC applicant: @swiftbotlab (Swift Bot Labs | NPC-ID: 6adde8a2000b9b3b853d | Track A: Existing App Activation | applied 2026-10-25)
Owner wallet: 0x2481E29895b43e87e547a50fB0BB5aa1E70585EB (this claim's sender)

What the app does: paste any Solana transaction signature or explorer link and get a plain-language receipt: what was given, what came back, what it cost, and where every lamport went, checked against the chain. Swaps, transfers and failed transactions, all in the browser.

How we bring the app and community together through an NPC Club:
1. Receipt requests: members post a transaction they don't understand and get its receipt in the Club.
2. Receipt of the week: a breakdown of a real swap, failed trade or fee trap, so members learn to read their own transactions.
3. Scam-pattern log: members collect drainer and hidden-fee patterns they have spotted, with receipts as proof.

Submitted to #1505 and #1506 so NPC can award whichever slot is open under the one-reward-per-builder rule.
